subject: Amended version of the transition guide

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Amended version of the transition guide
parts:
Hi all:

This version has a new section on the annotation functions that are
new to 0.9.0, starting on p. 21 of the attachment. Per discussion
about creating new scale functions here in the past week, I added some
material in the scales section on p. 36. There is one addition to the
'Visible changes' at the end of the first subsection, along with a
couple of typo fixes. Thanks to Ian Fellows, Brandon Hurr and Baptiste
Auguie for the useful feedback based on the last version.

As always, comments appreciated. Hopefully we can get this out the
door in the next day or two.

Dennis

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Amended version of the transition guide
parts:
Hi Dennis,

At this point, I think it's good enough to go to the main ggplot2
mailing list. You'll probably get quite a few more comments there,
especially as people actually start to use it. I think we should plan
for another edition on March 1.

Hadley
